hypothesised_pattern: Target class is class_2 when x4^2 - 0.3 exceeds about 1.8*|x2*x5|, and otherwise the sign of x2*x5 gives class_1 (positive) or class_0 (negative).
functional_form_guess: predict class_2 if x4^2 - 0.3 > 1.8*|x2*x5|, else class_1 if x2*x5 > 0, else class_0
rationale: With coefficient 1.85 and offset 0.25, idx 8 is a marginal miss: it is class 1 with x4^2 of about 0.48 and x2*x5 of about 0.11. Moving to 1.8 and 0.3 fixes it, and by my hand checks it also keeps the tight earlier boundary pairs on the correct sides, so all ten examples here fit. These values are approximate, because they rest on only a few samples near the boundary.
